text.en: 1. This Notification is the Platform Workers (Platform Work Associations — Expenditure of Funds) Notification 2024 and comes into operation on 1 November 2024.

1A. In this Notification —
“combined federation” has the meaning given by section 2 of the Trade Unions Act 1940;
“registered combined federation” means a combined federation registered under the Trade Unions Act 1940.
[S 1013/2024 wef 01/01/2025]
